notes.title: Hotfix #4 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Thank You For Your Application! Hotfix #4 contains the following changes:[/p][p]-Fixed a bug with the Renter's Portal data persistence, it should behave normally now.[/p][p]-Fixed a bug causing the Landlord's mouth to not animate in some events.[/p][p]-Fixed a bug that would softlock players if they submitted an application at midnight.[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where the Odd Jobs window would re-roll jobs while the window was still active.[/p][p]-Fixed a bug in the Party Clown game where the balloon popping animation doesn't play if you failed the first input of the sequence, it should behave normally now.[/p][p]-Reduced Dog Walking game time by 20 seconds to increase difficulty[/p][p]-Reduced Lawn Mowing game time by 10 seconds to increase difficulty[/p][p]-Rebalanced Moving Assistant game. Bonus pay is now paid out if there is less than 8 open spaces and there must be less than 16 open spaces to get the job's base pay. If you have 16 or more open spaces, you get nothing, you lose, good day sir.[/p][p]-Various minor animation tweaks & fixes[/p][p]-Various minor UI fixes[/p]

tags.bug: -Fixed a bug with the Renter's Portal data persistence, it should behave normally now.
-Fixed a bug causing the Landlord's mouth to not animate in some events.
-Fixed a bug that would softlock players if they submitted an application at midnight.
-Fixed a bug where the Odd Jobs window would re-roll jobs while the window was still active.
-Fixed a bug in the Party Clown game where the balloon popping animation doesn't play if you failed the first input of the sequence, it should behave normally now.

tags.balance_change: -Reduced Dog Walking game time by 20 seconds to increase difficulty
-Reduced Lawn Mowing game time by 10 seconds to increase difficulty

-Rebalanced Moving Assistant game. Bonus pay is now paid out if there is less than 8 open spaces and there must be less than 16 open spaces to get the job's base pay. If you have 16 or more open spaces, you get nothing, you lose, good day sir.

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
[p]Hotfix #3[/p][p]-Added an indicator for other applicants to the main job search window to help further immerse players in the job market satire[/p][p]-Shortened the delay on skipping & progressing dialog[/p][p]-Re-balanced the range for odd job cash payouts[/p][p]-Fixes Pool Cleaning game's debris counter not displaying properly[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where players reeling the Pool Cleaning net when the mini-game ended would be able to control the player character on the results screen[/p][p]-Fixes applications quota not displaying properly in applications window[/p][p]-Fixes UI scaling bug that made UI elements unusable at certain resolutions[/p][p]-Fixed Dogwalking game's tutorial window ('Start' button now works)[/p][p]-Fixed Rideshare game's controls not activating upon starting the mini-game[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where players stunned by rocks in the Lawn Mowing game when the mini-game ends would be able to continue controlling the lawn mower on the results screen[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where players stunned by hazards in the Window Cleaning game when the mini-game ends would be able to continue controlling the player character on the results screen[/p][p]-Fixed a typo in the Bong's interaction text[/p][p]-Fixed a bug that caused the flavor text UI to not update properly after returning from an odd job[/p][p]-Added and fixed various soundFX in odd job mini-games[/p][p]-Fixed the 'exit' button not appearing at the end of the Delivery mini-game at certain resolutions[/p][p]-Various minor small tweaks and fixes

Current known issues list:[/p][p]-The fading effect for loading screens will flicker at random[/p]

tags.feature: -Added an indicator for other applicants to the main job search window to help further immerse players in the job market satire

tags.balance_change: -Shortened the delay on skipping & progressing dialog
-Re-balanced the range for odd job cash payouts

tags.bug: -Fixes Pool Cleaning game's debris counter not displaying properly
-Fixed a bug where players reeling the Pool Cleaning net when the mini-game ended would be able to control the player character on the results screen
-Fixes applications quota not displaying properly in applications window
-Fixes UI scaling bug that made UI elements unusable at certain resolutions
-Fixed Dogwalking game's tutorial window ('Start' button now works)
-Fixed Rideshare game's controls not activating upon starting the mini-game
-Fixed a bug where players stunned by rocks in the Lawn Mowing game when the mini-game ends would be able to continue controlling the lawn mower on the results screen
-Fixed a bug where players stunned by hazards in the Window Cleaning game when the mini-game ends would be able to continue controlling the player character on the results screen
-Fixed a typo in the Bong's interaction text
-Fixed a bug that caused the flavor text UI to not update properly after returning from an odd job

tags.feature: -Added and fixed various soundFX in odd job mini-games

tags.bug: -Fixed the 'exit' button not appearing at the end of the Delivery mini-game at certain resolutions

notes.title: Hotfix #2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]This patch fixes the following issues:[/p][p]-Fixed a major regression bug with the last patch that caused countless issues (sorry everyone)
-Fixed a bug where returning from an Odd Job would softlock the player by repeating the door event for the player's first Odd Job
-Fixed a bug causing multiple mini-game tutorial windows to be unresponsive to player input
-Fixed the text part of the players status meters so it should display properly now
-Fixed a bug causing the desktop PC to open with a broken version of the Load Game UI present[/p][p]-Numerous misc. visual bug fixes[/p][p][/p][p]Current Known Issues:[/p][p]-Random flickering when loading into a scene[/p][p]-Pool Cleaning Mini-Game debris counter currently doesn't track properly.[/p][p][/p][p]-Kaiju[/p]

tags.bug: -Fixed a major regression bug with the last patch that caused countless issues (sorry everyone)
-Fixed a bug where returning from an Odd Job would softlock the player by repeating the door event for the player's first Odd Job
-Fixed a bug causing multiple mini-game tutorial windows to be unresponsive to player input
-Fixed the text part of the players status meters so it should display properly now
-Fixed a bug causing the desktop PC to open with a broken version of the Load Game UI present
-Numerous misc. visual bug fixes
